business_problem: Claims Connection Group needed to help carriers, agents, policyholders, and repair partners interpret dense insurance policy language quickly and consistently because manual review delayed claims decisions, drove no-pay disputes, and increased inbound calls after storms.
solution_summary: CCG and IBM built LEXXARI as a policy-interpretation platform that uses IBM watsonx and watsonx Orchestrate to read, summarize, and guide users through complex insurance documents. In just 14 weeks, the teams modeled the workflow around real interactions among carriers, agents, and policyholders so the assistant could do more than answer isolated questions. Watsonx was trained on real-world insurance policies to generate fast interpretations, while watsonx Orchestrate coordinates the AI agents that guide users through step-by-step actions during claims handling. The resulting platform turns hours of dense policy review into immediate, decision-ready insight that insurance professionals can use in the field and customers can understand more clearly. Because the experience is grounded in policy content and operational workflows, it reduces confusion, improves claims consistency, and creates a reusable document-intelligence pattern CCG plans to extend into other document-heavy industries.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx
solution_components.role: Provides the AI model layer that reads and interprets real insurance policies for users.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates AI agents and workflows so users receive step-by-step guidance during claims analysis.

data_flow: Insurance policy documents are ingested into watsonx for summarization and interpretation, watsonx Orchestrate routes the resulting insight through workflow steps that mirror claims handling, and users receive immediate guidance or answers instead of manually re-reading policy text.
business_outcome: LEXXARI accelerated policy review, reduced no-pay claims and post-storm call volume, and gave field professionals faster, more confident guidance during claims handling.
architecture_clues: The workflow was designed to mirror how carriers, agents, and policyholders interact with policy data.
IBM watsonx was trained on real-world insurance policies.
CCG plans to expand the same platform into auto, legal, government, and education.
